desc:
🩸⚠ This is a gore engine game! Beware of what you're about to play, it's not for the faint of hearts!!

A game that all started from my ponder: "How come there is no Happy Wheels inspired gore engine in Roblox where the characters actually break to pieces, yet?"

The game inherits most of the mechanisms of the original game, but with some unique alterations like being able to use your legs, allowing for an obby-like gameplay but in Happy Wheels style.

It's also a game mostly made by a one-man team, and is in Beta, meaning the players are the testers. So if you find any bugs/flaws, feel free to message my group wall
